title: Type query for encoded vertices
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, let $j$ be one of the five query indices, let $t$ be an optional gate kind, and let $n,v$ be natural numbers. If the query language at index $j$ is the language of vertices of type $t$, then the Boolean indicator of that query language on the encoding of $1^n$ paired with the binary expansion of $v$ equals true exactly when $v$ is less than the size of the circuit on $n$ inputs and vertex $v$ has type $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $j$ is in the five-element query index set
the query language at $j$ equals the type language for $t$
